about_the_game:
Blast through waves of enemies in the explosive and fast-paced shoot 'em up inspired by the world of Brainrot! Fight your way through to rescue Ballerina Capuchina from the slippered fins of Tralalero Tralala.

This is a side-scrolling shoot 'em up packed with action and bullet hell chaos—though carefully tuned to keep things fun rather than frustrating. Dive into the 30 intense stages of Bombardiro Crocodilo MISSION and take on the challenge. Defeat the three major bosses from the three story zones to finally set Ballerina Capuchina free from the clutches of Tralalero Tralala and his henchmen.

Features:

  • Play as Bombardiro Crocodilo in this explosive shoot 'em up

  • Fast, fluid, and frantic gameplay

  • Unlock over 12 playable characters from the world of Brainrot, including Bombardini Cusini Ballerina Capuchin and more!

  • Kill waves of enemies in over 30 handcrafted stages.

  • Blast through waves of enemies

  • Collect coins to unlock skins inspired by the world of Brainrot

  • Unlock skins like Bombardiro Crocodilo, Bombardini Gusini, Ballerina Capuchina, and many more

  • Use various types of bullets with unique characteristics

  • Defeat the 3 main bosses from the Brainrot universe: Chimpancini Bananini, Tung Tung Shaur, and Tralalero Tralala

  • Explore 30 thrilling stages

  • Enjoy the exotic original soundtrack crafted for your journey as the savior of Ballerina Capuchina

short_description: In this fun and frenetic shooter, you'll play as Bombardiro Crocodilo, who's trying to save Ballerina Capuchina from Tralalero Tralala's shoed fins. Embark on an action-packed journey with tons of shooting, different weapons, and skins from the Brainrot universe!
